run_qinco_train: run the qinco training task using run.py with task=train and a Hydra config
run_qinco_eval: run the qinco evaluation task using run.py with task=eval and a Hydra config
run_qinco_convert: run the qinco convert task using run.py with task=convert to transform model weights
run_qinco_search: run the qinco search task using run.py with task=search to perform vector search
run_qinco_build_index: run the qinco build_index task using run.py with task=build_index to construct a search index
